title: 第19章 阴阳混沌炎第20章 再压寒毒
slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 柳如烟被叶峰突然愤怒吓了一跳，娇躯不由后退了几步，就连万古钟也从掌心中滑落。
“叶哥哥，对不起。”
柳如烟紧闭双眼，不敢看叶峰，哭着说道。
随即就准备将这几日发生的所有事情，都跟叶峰全盘托出。
然后还没等柳如烟开口，一道惊喜的声音忽然响起，“这是…万古钟！”
闻言，柳如烟睁开双眼，只见叶峰正满脸激动地将小巧精致的万古钟捧在掌心，随即又继续说道。
“原来如烟妹妹，是去找徐墨给我讨要万古钟了！
真是太抱歉了，我刚刚竟然误会你了。
你能原谅我吗？”
柳如烟见状顿时松了口气，笑着说道，“我从来没有怪过叶哥哥，又谈何原谅呢。”
闻听此话，叶峰看着手中的万古钟，内心愈发愧疚起来。
如烟妹妹分明是去帮他讨要万古钟了，而他却以那样的态度对待她，他可真不是人！
看着眼前梨花带雨的如烟妹妹，闻着对方身上若有若无的体香，叶峰愧疚的同时，也感觉小腹变得越来越火热。
他之前本打算等自己突破到合体后，再跟柳如烟表白的。
可是叶峰发现他扛不住了，他已经受够每天担惊受怕地看柳如烟出门，他害怕如烟妹妹出去找其他男人！
所以他要！
叶峰深呼一口气，用自己为最深情的目光，看向柳如烟。
“如烟妹妹，你明天有时间吗？
要是有的话，能不能陪我去后山悬崖一趟，那里景色优美……”
合欢圣地的后山悬崖，可以说是山清水秀，空气清新，乃是弟子们约会的绝佳场所。
他也准备在那里，向如烟妹妹表白，若是她同意的话，那就可以去后山的小树林，开始嘿嘿嘿了！
然后在叶峰幻想之时，柳如烟则是呆愣在了原地。
她不是傻子，自然清楚叶峰的意思。
但是，她已经不是清白之身了，现在更是徐墨的贴身侍女，可以说她已经不干净了！
现在的她，又有何面目接受叶峰的表白！
再者说，她明天还要准时去徐墨那里伺候他呢，不然她就得不到为叶峰治疗的圣丹了。
想到这，柳如烟只能低着头，小声说道，“叶哥哥，我明天还有重要的事做，我们过几天再研究吧！”
说要便跑回了洞府，独留满脸震惊的叶峰一人待在外面。
“如烟妹妹这是，拒绝我了？”
过了不知多久，叶峰才反应过来，有些惊疑道。
因为在他心中，柳如烟与他虽然没有捅破最后那层窗户纸，但是却早已确定了道侣关系。
如今柳如烟竟将他拒绝了！
这让叶峰惊讶的同时，也将刚刚消散的怀疑再度聚拢。
这时，林清音的虚影陡然出现，对叶峰轻声道，“峰儿，你难道没有感觉出，事情有些不对吗！
那徐墨就算再怎么喜欢如烟，也不可能把刚到手的顶尖圣器拱手相送啊！”
叶峰闻言，有些不确定，“师尊的意思是……”
“没错，为师认为柳如烟应该是与那徐墨，做了什么见不得人的交易！
或许她已经……”
还没等林清音说完，就直接被叶峰下意识的怒吼打断！
“绝对不可能！
我与如烟妹妹可是青梅竹马，是看着对方从小一起长大的，她怎么可能会和徐墨做那种事！
师尊，我希望你不要在我面前议论如烟妹妹！
否则，我就…就关闭自己的耳感！”
content_en:
Liu Ruyan was startled by Ye Feng's sudden anger. Her delicate body couldn't help but take a few steps back, and even the Eternal Bell slipped from her palm.
"Brother Ye, I'm sorry."
Liu Ruyan closed her eyes tightly, not daring to look at Ye Feng, and cried.
Immediately, he was ready to tell Ye Feng everything that had happened in the past few days.
Then before Liu Ruyan could speak, a surprised voice suddenly sounded, "This is... the Eternal Bell!"
Hearing this, Liu Ruyan opened her eyes and saw Ye Feng holding the small and exquisite Eternal Bell in his palm with excitement, and then continued to speak.
"It turns out that Sister Ruyan went to Xu Mo to ask for the Eternal Bell from me!
I'm so sorry. I misunderstood you just now.
can you forgive me? "
Liu Ruyan breathed a sigh of relief when he saw this, and said with a smile, "I have never blamed Brother Ye, so how can I forgive him."
After hearing this, Ye Feng looked at the Eternal Bell in his hand and felt increasingly guilty.
Sister Ruyan clearly went to help him ask for the Eternal Bell, but he treated her with such an attitude. He was really not a human being!
Looking at sister Ruyan with pear blossoms in front of him, and smelling the vague body fragrance on her body, Ye Feng felt guilty and at the same time felt his lower abdomen becoming more and more hot.
He had planned to wait until he broke through to merge before confessing to Liu Ruyan.
But Ye Feng found that he couldn't bear it anymore. He had had enough of watching Liu Ruyan go out in fear every day. He was afraid that sister Ruyan would go out to find other men!
So he wants it!
Ye Feng took a deep breath and looked at Liu Ruyan with his most affectionate eyes.
"Sister Ruyan, are you free tomorrow?
If so, could you accompany me to the cliff at the back of the mountain? The scenery there is beautiful..."
The cliff at the back of Hehuan Holy Land can be said to have beautiful scenery and fresh air, making it a perfect place for disciples to date.
He is also planning to confess his love to sister Ruyan there. If she agrees, then he can go to the grove in the back mountain and start having sex!
Then while Ye Feng was fantasizing, Liu Ruyan froze on the spot.
She was not a fool and naturally knew what Ye Feng meant.
However, she is no longer innocent, and now she is Xu Mo's personal maid. It can be said that she is no longer clean!
How could she accept Ye Feng's confession now?
Furthermore, she had to go to Xu Mo's place on time to serve him tomorrow, otherwise she would not get the holy elixir to treat Ye Feng.
Thinking of this, Liu Ruyan could only lower her head and whispered, "Brother Ye, I have important things to do tomorrow. Let's study it in a few days!"
After saying yes, he ran back to the cave, leaving a shocked Ye Feng alone outside.
"Sister Ruyan, are you rejecting me?"
After an unknown amount of time, Ye Feng finally reacted and said with some surprise.
Because in his heart, although Liu Ruyan and him had not broken through the last layer of window paper, they had already established a Taoist couple relationship.
Now Liu Ruyan actually rejected him!
While this surprised Ye Feng, it also brought back the doubts that had just dissipated.
At this time, Lin Qingyin's shadow suddenly appeared and whispered to Ye Feng, "Feng'er, don't you feel that something is wrong?
No matter how much Xu Mo liked Ru Yan, there was no way he would give away the top holy weapon he had just obtained! "
Ye Feng was a little unsure when he heard this, "Master means..."
"That's right, I think Liu Ruyan must have made some shady deal with Xu Mo!
Maybe she has..."
Before Lin Qingyin could finish speaking, she was directly interrupted by Ye Feng's subconscious roar!
"Absolutely impossible!
Sister Ruyan and I are childhood sweethearts. We have watched each other grow up together. How could she do something like that with Xu Mo!
Master, I hope you won’t talk about sister Ruyan in front of me!
Otherwise, I'll...just turn off my sense of hearing! "
